product_increment.primary_behavior: Present every selected Lab ontology source through one typed, queryable system map while preserving exact admission state, branch boundaries, source ownership, identity collisions, and unresolved residue.

acceptance_criteria: Every selected source digest is current.
Every relation endpoint and source reference resolves.
The graph is weakly connected from CAL-LAB-ONTOLOGY-SYSTEM.
Business, system, bridge, governance, and context branches remain distinguishable.
At least one realized_by relation has evidence from both business and system branches.
The 20-package legacy inventory and all 10 review groups remain queryable without silently choosing duplicate identities.
No candidate, approval, acceptance, or diagnostic record is inflated into admission.
Hostile mutations to digests, endpoints, authority state, duplicate handling, branch evidence, or canonical-truth boundaries fail closed.
operational_residue: Commit and publication remain owner-controlled and deferred.
Admission is a separate post-Product-approval decision.
Child ontology review and admission remain with their exact owners.
claim_ceiling: This immutable, tested candidate defines a cohesive Lab ontology-system Product increment and is eligible for one exact Product approval decision. It is not Product-approved or admitted and grants no authority or external effect.
